name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
February 24, 2009
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Senior Pastor Matthew Palm, Hope Church of the Nazarene
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring February 24, 2009, "Spay Day USA" in the City of Vista.
P2.
Presentation regarding BioSolids by Mike Hogan, Encina Wastewater Authority General Manager.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending December 31, 2008 (CC)
C4.
Amendment of Alcoholic Beverage Control (ABC) License for Jumping Bean Café, 785 Shadowridge Drive (CC)
C5.
2009 City Council Legislative Platform (CC)
C6.
Central Vista Business Improvement District (CVBID) (CC)
C7.
Amendment of City Engineer Ordinance (CC)
C8.
Motorist Aid Grant (CC)
C9.
Revisions to City Council Policy 700-01, State and Federal Grants (CC)
C10.
State Revolving Funds for Sewer and Storm Drain Projects (CC/BSD)
DISCUSSION
D1.
Public Arts Commission "Kites over Vista" Approval (CC)
D2.
S. Santa Fe Avenue Drainage Project (CC/CDC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving a Second Amendment to the agreement with Tory R. Walker Engineering, Inc. for the S. Santa Fe Drainage Project, approving a reimbursement agreement with the Community Development Commission (CDC), and making findings regarding the payment by the CDC of certain costs related to public improvements for the benefit of the Vista Redevelopment Project Area; and
2.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2009- , approving a reimbursement agreement between the CDC and the City of Vista for the design of public improvements located in the Vista Redevelopment Project.
PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
Koval Revocable Living Trust Sewer Reimbursement Agreement (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving a Sewer Reimbursement Agreement between the City of Vista and Richard P. Koval, Trustee of the Koval Revocable Living Trust, owner's agent for APN 171-172-16 and 171-172-17; and
2.
Direct the City Clerk to file the resolution, agreement, and Notice of Encumbrance with the San Diego County Recorder.
PH2.
Zoning Code Amendment Regarding Commercial Outdoor Cooking (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony regarding the proposed amendment to the Development Code; and 2 Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2009- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 18.38 of the Development Code Relating to Commercial Outdoor Cooking Facilities."
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
